name: Ask about mental health coverage in insurance
goal: User asks if mental health treatments are covered under employee insurance.
constraints: Bot must use only KB info, personalize reply, and cite correct source and signed URL. No external info or filler.

testdata.query: Does our group mediclaim cover mental health treatments?

phases.description: User asks about mental health coverage under group mediclaim.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds with Arjun Nair's name/designation, confirms if covered, states limits if any, and cites correct source with signed URL.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
